_note: Held opener (T6-4 held scene openers (97156c2f, src/runtime/openerDeferral.ts + EffectsApplier.fireOnEnter/releaseOpener)): an onEnter npc_reply entered while the last reply addresses the player waits. The fixture makes that deterministic with an Arin line ending on a question, asserts the opener is held (no line, no npcFired), still held after the player line alone, fires once at the next rendered reply after the player answered (a /sendas line, the same afterSpeak path as a real reply), lands after the player line, and never fires again.
